title: Re-Export
summary: RE-EXPORT, verb transitive [re and export.] To export again; to export what has been imported. In the United States, a drawback is allowed on commodities re-exported. RE-EX'PORT, noun Any commodity re

inlines.v: RE-EXPORT, verb transitive [re and export.] To export again; to export what has been imported. In the United States, a drawback is allowed on commodities re-exported. RE-EX'PORT, noun Any commodity re-exported.
